relevant_laws.quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.
relevant_laws.notes: A compatible mountain-road curve can supply the required location and physical occlusion without changing the fixed layout. Conditions remain explicit: A curved mountain-road turning location, documented terrain occlusion and supported swept path.; Document visibility from both approach directions within 500 feet with explicit nonlegal measurement conventions.; Establish highway status, qualifying vehicle and driver physical control; preserve unresolved visibility meanings and actual-traffic necessity.; Other vehicle's route, position, motion and approach direction.; Qualifying highway and conventional motor vehicle under identified physical control.; Raw visibility evidence from each approach direction within 500 feet.; Specify the curve, terrain occluders and realizable reversal envelope.; Specify the other vehicle's route, approach direction, position and motion.
